channel.title: The Patient Sky
channel.description: Plain-words writing on Morin's method of astrology and the craft of timing, by Bala Danmeri.

item.title: Primary directions in astrology, explained plainly
item.author: info@baladanmeri.com (Bala Danmeri)
item.description: How the turning of the sky after birth becomes a year of life, the two time keys, zodiacal and mundane directions, and why a direction needs the chart's promise, with the real arcs from my own forecast.

item.title: Morin's method of astrology, in plain words
item.author: info@baladanmeri.com (Bala Danmeri)
item.description: Who Jean-Baptiste Morin was, the one rule at the heart of his method, and how four steps narrow a forecast from a year to a day, with a worked example from my own forecast.
